name: Peptide Therapy
description: Peptide therapy is a general term for prescribing peptides under medical supervision. Some peptide drugs are FDA-approved for specific uses; many are not.

name: Semaglutide
description: Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist, FDA-approved as Wegovy for chronic weight management and as Ozempic and Rybelsus for type 2 diabetes. Prescription required; compounded versions are not FDA-approved.

name: NAD+
description: NAD+ is a coenzyme found in the body's cells. Some clinics offer it by injection or IV infusion; ask a licensed provider about its regulatory status and the evidence for your use.

name: Tirzepatide
description: Tirzepatide is a dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist, FDA-approved as Zepbound for chronic weight management and as Mounjaro for type 2 diabetes. Prescription required; compounded versions are not FDA-approved.

name: Sermorelin
description: Sermorelin is a synthetic analog of growth hormone-releasing hormone. Prescription required; compounded sermorelin is not FDA-approved.

name: Glutathione
description: Glutathione is a tripeptide made by the body. Some clinics offer it by injection or IV; ask a licensed provider about its regulatory status and the evidence for your use.

name: PT-141
description: PT-141 (bremelanotide) is a melanocortin receptor agonist. An approved bremelanotide product exists for one specific indication; other uses are off-label, and compounded versions are not FDA-approved.

name: HCG
description: HCG (human chorionic gonadotropin) is a hormone. HCG products are FDA-approved for specific fertility and hormone indications; other uses are off-label. Prescription required.

name: BPC-157
description: BPC-157 is a synthetic peptide being studied, mostly in animals, for tissue repair. It is not FDA-approved.

name: GHK-Cu
description: GHK-Cu is a copper peptide being studied for skin and wound healing. It is not FDA-approved as a drug.

name: TB-500
description: TB-500 is a synthetic peptide related to thymosin beta-4, being studied for tissue repair. It is not FDA-approved.

name: Tesamorelin
description: Tesamorelin is a growth hormone-releasing hormone analog. An approved tesamorelin product exists for one specific indication; other uses are off-label, and compounded versions are not FDA-approved.

name: CJC-1295 / Ipamorelin
description: CJC-1295 and Ipamorelin are synthetic peptides studied for their effects on growth hormone release. They are not FDA-approved.

name: MOTS-c
description: MOTS-c is a mitochondrial-derived peptide being studied in metabolic research. It is not FDA-approved.

name: AOD-9604
description: AOD-9604 is a modified fragment of human growth hormone being studied in metabolic research. It is not FDA-approved.

name: Liraglutide
description: Liraglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist, FDA-approved as Saxenda for chronic weight management and as Victoza for type 2 diabetes, with generic versions available. Prescription required.

name: Epithalon
description: Epithalon (Epitalon) is a synthetic tetrapeptide being studied in aging research. It is not FDA-approved.

name: Oxytocin
description: Oxytocin is a peptide hormone. Oxytocin products are FDA-approved for specific obstetric uses; other uses are off-label, and compounded versions are not FDA-approved.

name: Semax
description: Semax is a synthetic peptide being studied for effects on cognition and the nervous system. It is not FDA-approved.

name: Thymosin Alpha-1
description: Thymosin Alpha-1 is a peptide being studied for its effects on the immune system. It is not FDA-approved.

name: 5-Amino-1MQ
description: 5-Amino-1MQ is a small molecule (not a peptide) being studied in metabolic research. It is not FDA-approved.

name: Selank
description: Selank is a synthetic peptide being studied for effects on anxiety and cognition. It is not FDA-approved.

name: Hexarelin
description: Hexarelin is a synthetic peptide studied for its effects on growth hormone release. It is not FDA-approved.

name: Retatrutide
description: Retatrutide is an investigational GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist. It is not FDA-approved, and FDA says it cannot be used in compounding under federal law.

name: SS-31
description: SS-31 (elamipretide) is a mitochondria-targeted peptide studied in mitochondrial disease research. Compounded versions are not FDA-approved.

name: Melanotan-2
description: Melanotan-2 is a synthetic peptide sold for tanning. It is not FDA-approved, and serious adverse effects have been reported.

name: Kisspeptin
description: Kisspeptin is a peptide involved in reproductive hormone signaling, being studied for fertility and hormone conditions. It is not FDA-approved.

name: DSIP
description: DSIP (delta sleep-inducing peptide) is a peptide being studied for effects on sleep. It is not FDA-approved.

name: IGF-1 LR3
description: IGF-1 LR3 is a modified form of insulin-like growth factor-1. It is not FDA-approved.

name: GHRP-2
description: GHRP-2 is a synthetic peptide studied for its effects on growth hormone release. It is not FDA-approved.

name: GHRP-6
description: GHRP-6 is a synthetic peptide studied for its effects on growth hormone release. It is not FDA-approved.

name: Hormone Therapy
description: Hormone therapy, including hormone replacement therapy (HRT), is prescribed by licensed providers for testosterone, estrogen, thyroid, and other hormone conditions.

name: IV Therapy
description: IV therapy delivers fluids, vitamins, or other nutrients intravenously. Ask a licensed provider whether it is appropriate for you.

name: Weight Loss
description: Medical weight management programs, which may include FDA-approved GLP-1 medications such as semaglutide and tirzepatide. Prescription required.
